final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_shortintrt) AS overall_avg_shortintrt FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT step1.transref, step1.ordertypedist, step1.avg_shortintrt, step1.avg_optvolrt, step1.avg_shortintrt * 1.0 / NULLIF(step2.overall_avg_shortintrt, 0) AS ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY = step2.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
